REGOLITH — macOS
================

A retro isometric alien-colony builder. Prospect for hidden subsurface
deposits, mine them, and build toward launching the xenite beacon.


HOW TO RUN IT
-------------

1. Drag Regolith.app wherever you like (Applications is a good spot).

2. THE FIRST TIME ONLY: right-click (or Control-click) Regolith.app and
   choose "Open", then click "Open" again in the dialog that appears.

   If you just double-click it instead, macOS will say something like
   "Regolith can't be opened because Apple cannot check it for malicious
   software". That is macOS being careful about apps that weren't signed
   with a paid Apple Developer account — it is not a sign that anything is
   wrong with the game. Right-click -> Open is the normal way past it, and
   you only have to do it once.

3. If macOS instead claims the app "is damaged and can't be opened", that's
   the quarantine flag macOS attaches to downloaded files. Open Terminal and
   run this against wherever you put it:

       xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Regolith.app


CONTROLS
--------

  Left mouse    place a building / inspect one
  Right mouse   demolish (refunds half the cost) / cancel placement
  WASD          pan the camera
  Z             zoom
  P             prospecting overlay        O  building status overlay
  M             overhead map               F1 debug coordinates
  Space         pause          1 / 3       game speed
  Esc           menu (save, sound on/off, quit)


WHERE SAVES LIVE
----------------

  ~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/Regolith/

The game autosaves every few minutes, and Esc -> Save Game makes a manual
save. Deleting that folder resets everything.
